# Properties the nightly soak (soak.yml) runs, by test name, without
# packages so a package move needs no edit here. Each must report exactly one
# pass: missing, skipped or doubled fails the soak. A test whose name matches
# Rapid or Propert must be listed, here or below with "-" and the reason it is
# not soaked. A subtest may skip only if listed as "~Test/sub reason"; a
# property must also log Rapid's "OK, passed N tests" with N > 0.
